name: auto-height
title: Auto height
description: A container that glides to its new height when its content changes, for form steps, inline errors and swapped panels, without ever clipping a focus ring.
docs: Wrap the part of a layout whose height changes. A ResizeObserver watches the content, so it follows your own state, images that load and text that wraps. Height is pinned only while it moves; afterwards it is auto again and overflow is released, so focus rings and shadows are never clipped. Give it aria-live="polite" when what appears is a message (an inline error), and keep the element mounted so the region exists before its content does. Reduced motion applies the change at once; pass disabled to turn the glide off.
